name: AnimatedNumberCounter
src_typeComment: Drop on a TMP_Text and call SetValue(newValue) instead of writing text.text directly — the displayed number ticks smoothly toward the target instead of snapping, which reads much better for score/currency changes. numberFormat controls how the number itself is rendered; the separate `format` string still wraps it for a prefix/suffix (e.g. "{0} coins").

src_serialized.name: countDuration
src_serialized.tooltip: Seconds to animate from the current displayed value to a new target — recalculated each time SetValue() changes the target, so a big jump and a small jump both finish in the same time (a true constant-speed chase, not one that eases out as it nears the target).

src_serialized.name: numberFormat
src_serialized.tooltip: How the number itself is rendered.

src_serialized.name: currencySymbol
src_serialized.tooltip: Only used when Number Format is set to Currency.

src_serialized.name: format
src_serialized.tooltip: Optional prefix/suffix, e.g. \" coins\" — {0} is replaced with the formatted number.

src_members.sig: public void SetValue(float newValue, bool instant = false)
src_members.name: SetValue
